## Author checklist (before Ready for review)
- [ ] PR is Draft while work is in progress
- [ ] Scope is coherent for this phase and excludes unrelated changes
- [ ] Description explains what changed, why, impact, and rollout notes
- [ ] Required checks are green
- [ ] Merge conflicts are resolved

## During review
- [ ] Every review comment is addressed (change, rationale, or follow-up task)
- [ ] Threads are resolved only after update or reviewer agreement
- [ ] Re-requested review after substantial updates
- [ ] PR moved back to Draft if major rework was required
